bot.name: Hospital Appointment Booking - Single Branch
bot.description: Single-branch hospital appointment automation with WhatsApp OTP verification, department or doctor selection, schedule-backed slot booking, pay-at-hospital confirmation, and reminder scheduling.

messages.text: If this is a medical emergency, call {{emergency_phone}} or go to the nearest emergency department now. I will also connect you to the emergency team.

messages: Share callback and location details for emergency escalation. Do not wait for the chat if the situation is urgent.
Connecting you to the emergency support team now. Keep calling {{emergency_phone}} if the situation is urgent.

messages.text: I will help you book an appointment for this hospital. I will verify the patient's mobile number first, then continue through department or doctor selection, slot selection, and confirmation.

messages: Please share the remaining patient details for the appointment.
Choose the department. If you are not sure, select Not sure / describe issue or type your concern in your own words.
Please describe the health concern in your own words. I will match it to the right department and continue the booking.

data.instructions: Review the patient concern using only the routing context. Return exactly one allowed department key and no explanation. If the concern is clearly urgent or life-threatening, return emergency_medicine. If the concern is too broad or lacks enough detail for a specialty, return general_medicine.
data.contextTemplate:
Hospital department routing reference for appointment booking:
- Allowed department keys only: general_medicine, orthopedics, neurology, obstetrics, neurosurgery, cardiology, dermatology, pediatrics, gynecology, ent, ophthalmology, gastroenterology, endocrinology, pulmonology, psychiatry, urology, nephrology, general_surgery, rheumatology, oncology, physiotherapy, dentistry, diabetology, emergency_medicine.
- Orthopedics: bone, fracture, joint, knee, hip, shoulder, back, spine, muscle, ligament, sports injury.
- Neurology: migraine, recurrent headache, seizure follow-up, nerve pain, numbness, tingling, memory concerns, tremor, balance issues, stroke follow-up when not an emergency.
- Obstetrics: pregnancy, antenatal care, pregnancy check-up, labour planning, postpartum follow-up, maternity-related concerns.
- Neurosurgery: brain surgery review, spine surgery review, disc compression needing surgical opinion, spinal cord compression, hydrocephalus, brain or spine tumor surgical opinion.
- Cardiology: chest pain without obvious trauma, palpitations, blood pressure, heart-related symptoms.
- Dermatology: skin rash, allergy, itching, acne, pigmentation, hair or nail concerns.
- Pediatrics: infant, child, vaccination, child fever, child cough, growth concerns.
- Gynecology: menstrual issues, pregnancy, fertility, women's health symptoms.
- ENT: ear pain, hearing issue, sinus, nose block, throat pain, tonsils, voice concerns.
- Ophthalmology: eye pain, redness, blurred vision, watering, irritation.
- Gastroenterology: stomach pain, acidity, vomiting, digestion, liver, bowel concerns.
- Endocrinology: thyroid, hormone, metabolic or endocrine disorders.
- Pulmonology: cough, asthma, breathing issues, lung concerns when not emergency.
- Psychiatry: anxiety, depression, sleep, stress, behavior, mental health concerns.
- Urology: urine problems, bladder, prostate, male urinary concerns.
- Nephrology: kidney disease, renal issues, dialysis-related concerns.
- General surgery: hernia, piles, gallbladder, appendix, surgical opinion.
- Rheumatology: autoimmune joint pain, inflammatory arthritis, connective tissue disorders.
- Oncology: cancer diagnosis, tumor, chemotherapy, radiation follow-up.
- Physiotherapy: rehab, recovery exercise, mobility support after injury or surgery.
- Dentistry: teeth, gums, jaw, mouth pain, dental cleaning or cavities.
- Diabetology: diabetes review, sugar control, diabetic follow-up.
- General medicine: broad fever, infection, weakness, headache, body pain, unclear adult symptoms.
- Emergency medicine: severe chest pain, trouble breathing, stroke-like symptoms, severe bleeding, unconsciousness, seizure, major trauma, collapse, or any immediately life-threatening concern.
- If the concern is broad or unclear but not urgent, prefer general_medicine.
- Output must be one department key only and nothing else.
